title: Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\% regime. translated_title: 深度学习中面向时空参数更新应用的事件驱动参数动力学
translated_abstract: 标准神经网络训练通常在每次迭代时都将优化器生成的更新信号应用于模型参数。这项工作引入了参数更新的时空视角，提出事件驱动参数动力学（Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics, EPD），通过一个具有累积、事件触发释放和重置机制的中间状态，将候选更新的生成与其应用过程分离。在一个典型的按坐标实例化中，累积产生时间上的积分，释放施加空间上的预算约束，重置则分隔相继的释放区间，而传统的密集参数更新可作为边界情形被恢复。在CIFAR-100上的四种模型—优化器配置实验中，即使在每一步仅释放一小部分坐标（包括1%的情形）的情况下，EPD仍能保持接近传统训练的最终性能。匹配对照实验进一步表明，时间累积、状态依赖的选择性释放（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出事件驱动参数动力学（EPD），通过中间状态的累积、事件触发释放与重置机制将候选更新的生成与应用在时空上解耦，在CIFAR-100上即使每步仅释放1%的参数坐标也能保持接近常规训练的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which decouples candidate-update generation from their application via an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset, maintaining near-conventional training performance on CIFAR-100 even when only 1% of parameter coordinates are released at each step.
